title.zh: 菲律宾宣布降低大米进口关税
title.en: Philippines announced a rice import tariff cut

summary.zh: 第 62 号行政命令将大米配额内、外关税从 35% 调整为 15%。此处记录 2024 年的政策宣布，不代表今天适用的税率。
summary.en: Executive Order 62 reduced both in-quota and out-of-quota rice tariffs from 35% to 15%. This records the 2024 announcement, not today's applicable rate.

transmission.zh: 进口税降低可能减少到岸成本；是否传导到零售价还取决于汇率、库存和流通环节。
transmission.en: Lower import duties may reduce landed costs; retail pass-through also depends on exchange rates, inventories and distribution.

source.title: Presidential announcement of revised tariff rates

title.zh: UNCTAD 发布红海等航道受阻评估
title.en: UNCTAD assessed disruption to Red Sea shipping

summary.zh: UNCTAD 报告商船遇袭影响苏伊士通航，并与黑海战争及巴拿马低水位问题叠加。日期指报告发布日，不是冲突起始日。
summary.en: UNCTAD reported that attacks on merchant vessels disrupted Suez shipping alongside Black Sea war and Panama low-water pressures. The date is the assessment date, not the conflict's onset.

transmission.zh: 绕航可能延长交货时间并增加燃料、运费及保险成本；不能据此量化某种粮食的涨价幅度。
transmission.en: Rerouting can extend delivery times and raise fuel, freight and insurance costs; it does not establish a specific food-price increase.

title.zh: 印度限制非巴斯马蒂白米出口
title.en: India restricted non-basmati white rice exports

summary.zh: 印度当日将非巴斯马蒂白米出口调整为禁止类，即时实施；该公告未改变蒸谷米和巴斯马蒂米政策。仅记录当时措施。
summary.en: India prohibited non-basmati white rice exports with immediate effect. That announcement left parboiled and basmati rice policy unchanged. This is a historical measure record.

transmission.zh: 限制一种米的出口可能改变进口国采购来源与替代品需求；实际影响取决于豁免、其他出口国供应及库存。
transmission.en: Restrictions on one rice variety can shift import sourcing and substitute demand, depending on exemptions, other exporters and inventories.

source.title: Non-basmati white rice export policy announcement

title.zh: 俄罗斯终止参与黑海粮食倡议的实施
title.en: Russia ended implementation of the Black Sea Initiative

summary.zh: 联合国秘书长通报俄罗斯决定终止倡议实施，并撤回黑海西北部航行安全保证。该记录不描述目前所有乌克兰出口通道。
summary.en: The UN Secretary-General reported Russia's decision to end implementation and withdraw navigation security guarantees in the northwestern Black Sea. This does not describe all present-day Ukrainian export routes.

transmission.zh: 安全保障变化可能影响航运可用性、保险和运输路径；替代通道与其他产地供应决定最终市场影响。
transmission.en: Changes to security guarantees can affect shipping availability, insurance and routing; alternative corridors and other origins shape the market response.

source.title: Press encounter on the Black Sea Initiative, 17 July 2023

title.zh: 黑海粮食倡议在伊斯坦布尔签署
title.en: Black Sea Grain Initiative signed in Istanbul

summary.zh: 倡议为乌克兰敖德萨、切尔诺莫尔斯克和尤日内三个港口的商业粮食出口提供通道框架。它是战争期间的历史安排，并非当前有效通道证明。
summary.en: The initiative established a framework for commercial food exports through Odesa, Chornomorsk and Yuzhny. This wartime arrangement is a historical record, not evidence of an active corridor today.

transmission.zh: 港口出口通道可使库存更易进入国际市场，但签署协议不等于立刻恢复全部装运能力。
transmission.en: Port access can make stored supplies more available internationally, but signing an agreement does not immediately restore full shipment capacity.

source.title: Remarks at the signing of the Black Sea Grain Initiative

title.zh: 印尼有条件恢复棕榈油出口
title.en: Indonesia conditionally reopened palm oil exports

summary.zh: FAO 记录印尼解除三周出口禁令，同时重新设立国内市场供应和价格义务；解除禁令并不意味着无条件自由出口。
summary.en: FAO recorded the lifting of the three-week ban with domestic supply and price obligations reinstated. Reopening was conditional, not unrestricted trade.

transmission.zh: 恢复出口可增加国际市场可供采购数量，但仍受国内供应义务和许可执行约束。
transmission.en: Reopening can increase export availability, subject to domestic supply obligations and permit implementation.

source.title: Indonesia palm oil export reopening, May 2022

title.zh: 印度允许部分已报关小麦继续出口
title.en: India allowed certain customs-registered wheat shipments

summary.zh: 印度允许在 2022 年 5 月 13 日或之前已交海关查验并完成系统登记的小麦货物出口。这是过渡性放宽，并非全面解除禁令。
summary.en: India allowed wheat consignments handed to customs for examination and registered by 13 May 2022 to be exported. This transitional relaxation was not a general lifting of the restriction.

transmission.zh: 过渡条款可缓解已有合同和在途货物受阻，但不能据此推断新订单可以自由出口。
transmission.en: Transitional provisions can ease disruption to existing shipments without implying unrestricted access for new orders.

title.zh: 印度调整小麦出口为禁止类并保留例外
title.en: India restricted wheat exports with specified exceptions

summary.zh: 7 月的官方答复回顾了 5 月 13 日小麦出口政策调整，并说明既有信用证和政府批准粮食安全出口等例外。
summary.en: A July official reply described the 13 May wheat export restriction, retaining exceptions for qualifying existing letters of credit and government-approved food-security shipments.

transmission.zh: 限制可能减少新增商业出口可用量；例外出口与其他供应来源仍需单独评估。
transmission.en: Restrictions can reduce availability for new commercial exports; permitted exceptions and alternative suppliers still matter.

source.title: Parliamentary reply on wheat export restrictions

title.zh: 印尼实施短期棕榈油出口禁令
title.en: Indonesia introduced a temporary palm oil export ban

summary.zh: FAO 后续政策记录确认禁令自 4 月 28 日开始，并于 5 月 23 日解除。此处保留历史起点，不能视为现行限制。
summary.en: FAO's later policy entry dates the ban from 28 April and its lifting to 23 May. This preserves the historical start, not a current restriction.

transmission.zh: 短期出口中断可能改变植物油采购安排；持续时间与替代油脂供应会影响调整幅度。
transmission.en: A temporary export interruption can redirect vegetable-oil sourcing; duration and substitute supplies affect the adjustment.

source.title: Indonesia palm oil export reopening, May 2022
